Logo and app icon
Brand · Brand/logo/*.svg (First Light) · fills from brand/dot and text/primary
The i with a step and a coral dot, set in Geist 600 and outlined. One lockup, one symbol, one app icon, mono variants for one-ink uses. Fills are token variables: ink is text/primary, the dot is brand/dot.
Clear space
Keep one dot diameter (x = 132.8 units in the lockup artwork, the width of the i's dot) clear on every side of the artwork. The dashed box is the clear zone; the four squares are x.

Minimum sizes
Derived from the 16 px favicon, whose dot is 3 px, the smallest dot we draw. Scale the artwork so its dot is never smaller: lockup 16 px, symbol 16 px, app icon 26 px tall. Below that, use the pixel-snapped favicon redraw.
Colour roles
No brand ink or paper token exists. Ink is text/primary and paper is background/window; the dot is brand/dot (graphic only, never text). The app icon is theme independent: its ground is the light ink, its i the dark-mode ink, its dot the dark-mode dot.
